game_concept: A survival strategy set in The Kingdom – Mill Stream, a stream-side windmill: the baker's apprentice must handle thieves while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Rename Rush: Pick valid variable names (no spaces, no leading digits) to unlock doors across the area.
theme: The Kingdom – Mill Stream: a stream-side windmill
core_gameplay_loop: In Mill Stream, repeat each round: Pick valid variable names (no spaces, no leading digits) to unlock doors across the area. Each round, thieves strike the royal vault, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the valid_names value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Protect the royal vault from thieves in Mill Stream: keep the valid_names meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 30-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: valid_names drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 30-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 1 (intro tier): Rename Rush
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Rename Rush' (Week 1 slot 11), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Mill Stream'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how valid_names changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against thieves in Mill Stream.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 30 seconds while valid_names > 0.
